summary:
EdgeEver is a self-hosted note-taking app with an Evernote-style three-pane layout. I signed in as maya and saved five views:
1. workspace-note: notebook tree, note list and the rich-text editor, open on the Customer Interviews synthesis note.
2. mind-map-editor: the mind map note "Second Brain", with its canvas toolbar.
3. ai-assistant: the AI chat side panel after running Summarize on a note. The stubbed AI reply is odd text that partly echoes its own instructions. The replay of this view had the chat-history menu open, but the harness still accepted it (similarity 0.99).
4. settings-models: the Models and agents settings page (/settings?tab=ai).
5. template-center: the grid of template cards (/templates).

Side effects to know about:
- Running Summarize created a chat that the app saves. After that, the AI panel stayed open when going back to /, and the saved workspace and mind map views were recorded before it existed. If those two are replayed against the same data, they may show this panel.
- I didn't capture tags, trash, attachments, plugins or search, to keep within five views.
